full_judgment: 3. Plaint case in short is that Banku Bihari Mondal, father of the plaintiff and defendant no.2 and grandfather of the defendant no. 1 acquired the suit land of lot no. 1/2(ka) and 3 by way of purchase in the name of his minor and eldest son, Baidya Nath, father of defendant no.1 and by way of 'Pattan' of lot no. 4(ka) of schedule `ka' from the `Zaminder'. Banku Bihari also took `Pattan' land of lot 4 of said schedule ka'. Thus, he become owner in possession of entire suit land. While he was thus in possession, Banku Bihari transferred land of schedule 'Ida' to one Surat Chandra Sarker.
